newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat futures sharply lower on crop report.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat futures sharply lower on crop report.

text.p: UK wheat futures closed sharply lower on Thursday following the release of Dalgety's harvest estimate.
Dalgety put the UK cereals crop at 24.57 million tonnes, the highest since 1986/87 before the introduction of set-aside.
"Today's report flushed out more sellers than we have seen for a long time," said a trader.
Wheat futures closed with losses between 0.90 and 1.35 stg a tonne on a turnover of 1251 lots. Most active November last traded at 104.59 stg, 1.25 stg below Wednesday's close.
Barley fell 0.30 to 0.15 stg a tonne after trading 167 lots.
In Amsterdam milling wheat futures were neglected.
In the UK cash sector no fob business was seen but delivered traders reported a hectic day.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein fetched 127 stg a tonne for Oct/Dec in the London area while 131 stg was paid in Liverpool.

Feed wheat in East Anglia traded down to 106 stg for Sep and 109 stg for Oct/Dec. Barley fetched 100 stg for Sep in East Anglia and 104 stg for Oct/Dec. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8062
